nodes.label: htmlAttrs lang=ar dir=rtl data-theme=dark
nodes.rationale: Dark is the default theme; the light theme exists in main.scss but is not switched on.

nodes.label: titleTemplate '%s | Codel - كودل'
nodes.rationale: Every title ends with the site name; pages without a title (static 404.html / 200.html shells) show just the site name because the separator is dropped when %s is empty.

nodes.label: theme-color meta #101411
nodes.rationale: Same value as --bg (charcoal-900); the one hex outside main.scss because a meta tag cannot read a CSS variable.

nodes.label: nuxt pinned to 4.6.4
nodes.rationale: Pinned exactly; do not bump without being asked.

nodes.label: Claude Flow session state (owned hooks: route, post-edit)
nodes.norm_label: claude flow session state (owned hooks: route, post-edit)

nodes.label: status ?? statusCode fallback
nodes.rationale: status is the current field, but an error revived from the server payload may carry only the older statusCode, so it falls back to it.

nodes.label: company.siteUrl (empty until domain known)
nodes.rationale: Left empty because the domain is unknown; filling it switches on canonical, og:url and an absolute og:image for every page.

nodes.label: addressParts / openingHours (JSON-LD shapes)
nodes.rationale: Repeat address and hours in the shape search engines need; must be changed together with address and hours.

nodes.label: نقطة بلس / Nuqta Plus (175,000 IQD, Windows)
nodes.norm_label: نقطة بلس / nuqta plus (175,000 iqd, windows)

nodes.label: Home page (الرئيسية)
nodes.rationale: Product rows show only owner facts (name, tagline, price, platform), not the draft descriptions or features.

nodes.label: Home company section (founding years + goal sentence)
nodes.norm_label: home company section (founding years + goal sentence)

nodes.label: Lime contact band
nodes.rationale: On the lime ground --focus is set to --on-accent so the focus ring stays visible.

nodes.label: Hero load sequence and scroll-drawn bars
nodes.norm_label: hero load sequence and scroll-drawn bars

nodes.label: Home 5/12 + 7/12 page grid with edge tracks
nodes.rationale: Every section shares one set of column lines, plus outer tracks reaching the window edge so a bar can start on a column line and run off the page.
nodes.norm_label: home 5/12 + 7/12 page grid with edge tracks

nodes.label: Unknown slug 404 (createError fatal)
nodes.rationale: statusText goes into the HTTP status line, which carries only plain ASCII; the Arabic message lives in app/error.vue.

nodes.label: WhatsApp link with prefilled product inquiry
nodes.norm_label: whatsapp link with prefilled product inquiry

nodes.label: Product screenshot gallery (16:10, object-fit contain)
nodes.rationale: Fixed frame prevents layout shift while images load; contain shows the whole screenshot instead of cropping.

nodes.label: No-library rule
nodes.rationale: No UI libraries, CSS frameworks, font/icon CDNs or new npm deps without owner approval; only nuxt, vue, vue-router and sass.

nodes.label: Semantic design tokens (CSS custom properties)
nodes.rationale: Components use semantic tokens only, never hex values or charcoal/lime primitives, so the design system stays the source of colour.

nodes.label: Brand lean (--slant-angle 10deg)
nodes.rationale: The site's one recurring motif: things you act on lean, things you read stay upright; labels are counter-skewed back upright.

nodes.label: Arabic-first RTL document
nodes.rationale: Primary audience reads Arabic; Latin names, phones and email sit in dir=ltr.

nodes.label: Single source of truth (two data files)
nodes.rationale: Facts live in company.ts and solutions.ts; pages import them, so a fact is changed in one place, never in a page.
nodes.norm_label: single source of truth (two data files)

nodes.label: Placeholder pages policy (noindex, unlinked, no sitemap)
nodes.norm_label: placeholder pages policy (noindex, unlinked, no sitemap)

nodes.label: SEO and sharing (siteUrl-gated canonical and og:url)
nodes.rationale: The domain is unknown, so no canonical or og:url is emitted and og:image stays relative; never guess a domain.
nodes.norm_label: seo and sharing (siteurl-gated canonical and og:url)

nodes.label: CSS-only optional motion
nodes.rationale: Load/scroll animations only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and @supports animation-timeline; animate transform/opacity only; the home hero is the one load sequence.

nodes.label: No-JS fallback via html.js class
nodes.rationale: Menu-collapsing styles sit under .js so without JavaScript the links remain a visible list and the menu button stays hidden.

nodes.label: Small-screen menu behaviour spec (below 60em)
nodes.rationale: Closes on Escape, outside press/focus, link click, route change and widening; listeners only while open; wideQuery and $nav-wide must stay in step.

nodes.label: Favicon (adaptive Codel symbol)
nodes.description: Codel symbol only (viewBox 303.32x117.31): the slanted interlocking 'co' monogram as one path with class 'm'. An inline <style> fills it charcoal #101411 by default and switches it to lime #c4f527 under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark).
nodes.rationale: One file serves both browser themes: ink mark on light tab bars, lime mark on dark tab bars, so the favicon stays visible without shipping two icons. The path data is byte-identical to the brand symbol files, so the mark is not redrawn.

nodes.label: Codel full logo (ink)
nodes.description: Full horizontal lockup (viewBox 671.68x117.31): the 'co' monogram followed by the slanted geometric letters d, e (three stacked bars) and l, reading 'codel'. Three paths, all filled charcoal #101411 (the same hex as the --bg token).
nodes.rationale: Ink variant for light grounds. Not used on the dark-first site's own surfaces; it exists for the declared but unswitched light theme and for print or partner use.

nodes.label: Codel full logo (lime)
nodes.description: Full 'codel' wordmark lockup (viewBox 671.68x117.31), same three paths as the ink and white versions, filled lime #c4f527 (the accent).
nodes.rationale: Lime variant for dark grounds only: lime on a light ground fails contrast, the same reason --accent-text exists for lime text.

nodes.label: Codel full logo (white)
nodes.description: Full 'codel' wordmark lockup (viewBox 671.68x117.31), same three paths, filled white #ffffff.
nodes.rationale: Default logo for the dark-first site: white on dark grounds. Per CLAUDE.md it is also the artwork centred on --bg #101411 in the 1200x630 share image public/brand/og.png, which must be re-rendered if this file changes.

nodes.label: Codel symbol (ink)
nodes.description: Symbol-only mark (viewBox 303.32x117.31): the slanted interlocking 'co' monogram as a single path filled charcoal #101411.
nodes.rationale: Compact mark for light grounds where the full wordmark does not fit.

nodes.label: Codel symbol (lime)
nodes.description: Symbol-only 'co' monogram (viewBox 303.32x117.31), single path filled lime #c4f527.
nodes.rationale: Compact accent mark for dark grounds only; lime fails contrast on light grounds.

nodes.label: Codel symbol (white)
nodes.description: Symbol-only 'co' monogram (viewBox 303.32x117.31), single path filled white #ffffff.
nodes.rationale: Compact mark for dark grounds, the site's default ground.

nodes.label: Codel 'co' monogram glyph
nodes.description: One compound path: a wide slanted rounded capsule with two counters, an open 'c' on the left (gap between y 45 and 74) and a closed 'o' on the right, joined by a shared baseline so the pair reads like a chain link or infinity loop. The identical path data appears in all three symbol files, the favicon and the first path of all three full logos.
nodes.rationale: The symbol is the first two letters of the Latin name Codel fused into one mark. Because every file reuses the exact same path, the mark must never be redrawn, stretched or recoloured outside these variants.

nodes.label: Codel Latin wordmark letterforms (d, e, l)
nodes.description: Second and third paths of the full logos: a 'd' built from a rounded bowl and a short slanted stem, an 'e' made of three stacked slanted bars, and an 'l' made of a slanted stem and a foot bar. Stems lean about 10 degrees (for example dx 20.78 over dy 117.31).
nodes.rationale: The wordmark is Latin only; there is no Arabic wordmark, so the site writes كودل as live text. Do not retype or recreate the letters.
nodes.norm_label: codel latin wordmark letterforms (d, e, l)

nodes.label: Logo variant-to-ground rule
nodes.description: Logo files live in public/brand/: -white on dark grounds, -ink on light grounds, -lime on dark grounds only. Do not recolor, stretch, redraw or retype the logo.
nodes.rationale: Keeps the mark legible and contrast-safe on every ground with a fixed set of approved colourways instead of ad-hoc recolouring.

nodes.label: Brand lean (--slant-angle 10deg)
nodes.description: The site's recurring motif: buttons, tags and decorative bars lean by skewX(calc(var(--slant-angle) * -1)) with --slant-angle 10deg, while text, inputs, cards and images stay upright.
nodes.rationale: The roughly 10 degree lean measured in the logo's stems matches --slant-angle, which suggests the UI lean is borrowed from the logo.

nodes.label: Codel share image (og.png)
nodes.description: 1200x630 Open Graph / social share card. A flat, near-black charcoal ground with a faint green cast (the --bg #101411) fills the whole frame. A single white uppercase 'CODEL' wordmark sits dead centre, about half the frame wide, with wide empty margins on every side. The letterforms are heavy, geometric and leaning forward: C and O join into one continuous linked shape, the D has an angled notch, the E is built from three separate parallel slanted bars, and the L ends in a slanted cut. No tagline, no Arabic text, no lime accent, no photography: a pure logo-on-ground card.
nodes.rationale: Gives link previews (WhatsApp, social, chat apps) a branded, legible thumbnail using only the approved white logo on the dark brand ground, so no logo recolouring or extra copy is needed. Rendered once with headless Chrome; must be re-rendered the same way if the logo or --bg changes.
